cipher.name: Base32AlphabetShift
cipher.idea: A custom substitution cipher that maps the standard English alphabet to a shifted version of itself, but uses a fixed, simple offset of 5 positions to provide a balance between obfuscation and ease of reasoning for the model. Non-alphabetic characters (numbers, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
cipher.encrypt_rules: For uppercase letters (A-Z), shift the character forward by 5 positions in the alphabet: encrypt(x) = (x - 65 + 5) % 26 + 65. For lowercase letters (a-z), shift the character forward by 5 positions: encrypt(x) = (x - 97 + 5) % 26 + 97. All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain unchanged.
cipher.decrypt_rules: For uppercase letters (A-Z), shift the character backward by 5 positions in the alphabet: decrypt(x) = (x - 65 - 5) % 26 + 65. For lowercase letters (a-z), shift the character backward by 5 positions: decrypt(x) = (x - 97 - 5) % 26 + 97. All other characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain unchanged.

example.plaintext: The quick brown fox jumps over 13 lazy dogs.
